verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 giving programmatic access to all compute resources, plus a GraphQL API for Pods, templates and Serverless endpoints with cURL examples. It also offers an S3-compatible storage API and Serverless SDKs for Python, JavaScript and Go, so the platform can clearly be driven programmatically. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
